# Pilot results - Pinecrest no-charge summer

From June through August 2025 the Pinecrest branch stopped charging for late returns, as a test for the network-wide decision on [[Clearwater Resolution|overdue fines]].

## Returns

Ninety-one percent of items came back within a week of their due date, the same rate as in summer 2024. Long-unreturned items did not increase.

## Patrons who came back

Pinecrest cleared balances for 260 blocked cardholders, and 212 of them borrowed something by the end of August. Children's cards made up almost half.

## Staff time

Desk staff logged about four fewer hours a week on payment disputes and cash handling.

## Limits

One branch, one season. Summer returns may differ from the school year.
